bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: The Munsell color system specifies every pigment along three orthogonal dimensions of Hue, Value (lightness), and Chroma (saturation).
core_mechanism_bullets: The Munsell color system specifies every pigment along three orthogonal dimensions of Hue, Value (lightness), and Chroma (saturation).
Mixing complementary opposites across the 12-step RYB color wheel neutralizes chroma into low-saturation chromatic grays.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: Adding 15 percent titanium white to ultramarine blue raises its Munsell Value (creating a tint) while slightly lowering Chroma saturation.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Mix a 5-step monochromatic value scale and a 3-step complementary neutralization strip using watercolor or acrylic primaries in 3 minutes.

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Every painting medium pairs dry pigment particles with a specific binder (gum arabic for watercolor, acrylic polymer, or linseed oil).
core_mechanism_bullets: Every painting medium pairs dry pigment particles with a specific binder (gum arabic for watercolor, acrylic polymer, or linseed oil).
Oil painting obeys the 'fat-over-lean' rule so upper flexible oil-rich layers never crack over faster-drying lower lean layers.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: Heavyweight 140-pound (300 gsm) cold-press rag paper absorbs watercolor washes without buckling when taped flat around all four borders.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Compare line-and-wash behavior across pen-and-ink, watercolor on 140-lb paper, soft 4B graphite, and pastel on a 4-square sampler sheet.
